name: Can I paint my new trim any color, or are there recommended finishes?

mainEntity.name: Can I paint my new trim any color, or are there recommended finishes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, new trim can be painted any color you desire to match or contrast with your walls and existing decor. The finish, however, is crucial. Semi-gloss or satin finishes are commonly recommended for trim. These finishes are more durable and easier to clean than flat paints, making them ideal for high-traffic areas where trim can accumulate dust or marks. They also provide a subtle sheen that highlights the trim's profile and creates a crisp, finished look. Proper priming is essential for optimal paint adhesion and longevity.
acceptedAnswer.description: New trim can be painted any color, but semi-gloss or satin finishes are recommended for durability, easy cleaning, and to highlight the trim's profile.
